content: NHS website for England Find information and services to help you manage your health Health A to Z Find out about conditions, symptoms, medicines, tests and treatments, including when to get help NHS services Find out about NHS services including GPs, pharmacies, prescriptions, hospitals and dentists Manage your health Order a repeat prescription View your test results Appointments and bookings at your GP surgery How to register with a GP surgery Find your NHS number NHS services Find a pharmacy Find a dentist Find a GP Find NHS talking therapies for anxiety and depression Find other NHS services Help from NHS 111 If you're worried about a symptom and not sure what help you need, NHS 111 can tell you what to do next. Go to 111.nhs.uk or call 111 . For a life-threatening emergency call 999.
